source: ISO 14001:2026 Environmental management systems. Clause references with our own summaries; no ISO text reproduced.
disclaimer: This repository is general information to help you understand and organize work on AI governance frameworks. It is not legal advice and does not guarantee compliance, certification or any regulatory outcome. Requirements are summarized in our own words; always check the official texts and get qualified advice for your situation.

requirements.title: Understanding the organization and its context
requirements.summary: Know the internal and external issues, including environmental conditions such as climate, that affect your EMS.
requirements.evidence: Context register with issues and environmental conditions; review date.

requirements.title: Needs and expectations of interested parties
requirements.summary: Identify interested parties, their requirements, and which become compliance obligations.
requirements.evidence: Interested-party register; link to compliance obligations.

requirements.title: Scope of the EMS
requirements.summary: Define the EMS boundaries and applicability, considering activities, products and services you control or influence.
requirements.evidence: Scope statement (documented information), available to interested parties.

requirements.title: Environmental management system
requirements.summary: Establish the EMS and its processes, informed by context.
requirements.evidence: EMS manual or process description; process interactions.

requirements.title: Leadership and commitment
requirements.summary: Top management is accountable for the EMS and integrates it into business processes.
requirements.evidence: Management review records; evidence of leaders' involvement and resources.

requirements.title: Environmental policy
requirements.summary: Set a policy committed to environmental protection, compliance and continual improvement.
requirements.evidence: Approved policy (documented information), communicated and available.

requirements.title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
requirements.summary: Assign and communicate EMS responsibilities, including reporting on EMS performance.
requirements.evidence: Role descriptions or RACI, appointment records.

requirements.title: Risks and opportunities — general
requirements.summary: Plan to address risks and opportunities from context, aspects and compliance obligations, including emergencies.

requirements.title: Environmental aspects
requirements.summary: Identify aspects and impacts with a life cycle perspective and determine significant aspects.
requirements.evidence: Aspects and impacts register with criteria and significant aspects (documented information).

requirements.title: Compliance obligations
requirements.summary: Identify and have access to legal and other requirements and how they apply.

requirements.title: Planning action
requirements.summary: Plan actions for significant aspects, obligations, risks and opportunities, and how to evaluate their effectiveness.

requirements.title: Environmental objectives and planning
requirements.summary: Set measurable objectives and plan what, who, when and how results are evaluated.

requirements.title: Planning of changes
requirements.summary: Plan changes to the EMS in a controlled way.

requirements.title: Resources
requirements.summary: Provide the resources the EMS needs.

requirements.title: Competence
requirements.summary: Ensure competence of people whose work affects environmental performance or obligations.

requirements.title: Awareness
requirements.summary: People know the policy, significant aspects, their contribution and consequences of non-conformance.

requirements.title: Communication
requirements.summary: Plan internal and external communication, including what obligations require.

requirements.title: Documented information
requirements.summary: Create, update and control EMS documents and records.
requirements.evidence: Document list, approvals, retention and access control.

requirements.title: Operational planning and control
requirements.summary: Control processes linked to significant aspects, including outsourced processes and life cycle stages.
requirements.evidence: Operational controls, contractor requirements, inspection records.

requirements.title: Emergency preparedness and response
requirements.summary: Prepare for and respond to potential emergencies; test responses.
requirements.evidence: Emergency plans, drill records, incident reports.

requirements.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
requirements.summary: Monitor environmental performance with calibrated equipment and evaluate results.

requirements.title: Evaluation of compliance
requirements.summary: Evaluate fulfilment of compliance obligations at planned intervals.

requirements.title: Internal audit
requirements.summary: Run an audit program with objectives, criteria and scope; report and act.

requirements.title: Management review
requirements.summary: Top management reviews the EMS with all required inputs and records decisions.

requirements.title: Continual improvement
requirements.summary: Improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the EMS to enhance environmental performance.

requirements.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
requirements.summary: React, find causes, act, verify effectiveness and update the EMS.
